description: key_use enc alone, on a P-256 key with use sig and a P-256 key with use enc, returns the use enc key; decided by ADR 0054 §2.3 (purpose): key_use enc gives U = enc, so the use sig member is out; with no alg there is no family or JWK alg check (§2.1, §2.2), neither member has key_ops (§2.4), and the selector has no kid; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
